correctness.rationale: The domain has exactly sixteen projective flat sign lines after normalization. Exact integer determinants exhaust every five-line rank test. No seven-line subset is full spark, while an explicit six-line witness has six nonzero maximal minors, so the capacity is exactly six. Exact enumeration counts 1088 six-line maximizers and exact group action yields five orbits of the stated sizes. The weak-phase-retrieval corollary follows from the published theorem that a real minimal weak-phase-retrieval family of size 2n-2 must be full spark, together with the invariance under nonzero row scaling.

value.rationale: The dimension-five case is the first open dimension singled out by the published minimal weak-phase-retrieval problem, while the known minimal examples in dimensions three and four use flat sign vectors. Proving that the entire flat-sign strategy has exact full-spark capacity six therefore rules out a natural published construction pattern at the first unresolved dimension. The exact maximizer count and symmetry-orbit classification add structural information beyond a single counterexample.
